test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Rakesh will win the lottery.

options.text: The lottery is won by Rakesh.
The lottery will have won by Rakesh.
The lottery will be won by Rakesh.
The lottery was won by Rakesh.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The lottery will be won by Rakesh**."
